docs.title: What Is Upscale SDK?
docs.text: UpscaleSDK is a Unity SDK that abstracts the platform-specific pieces every console/PC game needs to ship: input, save data, configuration, UI navigation, and build validation.

docs.title: Supported platforms
docs.text:
• Desktop — Windows, macOS, Linux
  • Xbox — Series X/S, One
  • PlayStation — PS4, PS5
  • Nintendo Switch

docs.title: Reading order
docs.text:
1. Getting Started — install the SDK and bootstrap it in a scene
  2. Manual → Core — one page per Core subsystem
  3. Manual → Platform — per-platform setup checklists
  4. API Reference — generated from the source tree

See also: Unity Compatibility · Roadmap

docs.title: Roadmap
docs.text: A snapshot of what is shipped, in progress, and planned. Dates are indicative and may shift as scope changes.

docs.title: Shipped
docs.text:
• Core runtime — Configuration, Saves, Input, UI navigation
  • Major console platforms
  • Build validation pipeline
  • Sample scenes — Input, Saves, UI

docs.title: Unity Compatibility
docs.text:
The SDK is developed against Unity LTS releases. The table below lists the Unity versions the SDK is verified against and the platform support state for each.

Unity Version Status Desktop Xbox PlayStation Switch 6000.3.12f Supported ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ 6000.2.10f Supported ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ 2023.1.22f1 Experimental ⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️ 2022.3.62f3 Experimental ⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️

Legend

  • ✅ — Verified on this Unity version
  • ⚠️ — Builds, but not fully validated; report issues if encountered
  • ❌ — Not supported

docs.title: public string XboxContainerName = ""
docs.text: Name of the Xbox save container. Valid characters for the path portion of the container name (up to and including the final forward slash) includes uppercase letters (A-Z), lowercase letters (a-z), numbers (0-9), underscore (), and forward slash (/). The path portion may be empty. Valid characters for the file name portion (everything after the final forward slash) include uppercase letters (A-Z), lowercase letters (a-z), numbers (0-9), underscore (), period (.), and hyphen (-). The file name may not be empty, end in a period or contain two consecutive periods. The maximum length for the container name is 256 characters.
